as_told.title: Ian Stevenson's reincarnation research at the University of Virginia

plain: A researcher named Ian Stevenson is said to have spent decades at the University of Virginia, from about the 1960s, collecting cases of young children who spontaneously remembered past lives. The philosopher Jason Jorjani describes "hundreds and hundreds" of such cases and calls the work "extremely rigorous." A documentary filmmaker named Ky Dickens adds a story from Stevenson's fieldwork in India: when he said he was trying to prove past lives, locals asked why he was bothering, since they already knew it was real. They raise it because, if true, it would suggest something of a person survives death.
